description: Experiment F, failure and recovery (phase 14 work order 5, cloud window 2). One poison message (a body that is not a job-message-v1 object) is sent to the job queue; the worker logs it as poison-message and never deletes it (modules/services Worker.scala), so it is received 3 times, 300 s apart, and the redrive policy (maxReceiveCount 3) moves it to scholarchain-course-jobs-dlq. Alongside, one async POST /v1/query (benchmark B07) with an Idempotency-Key is replayed twice (while queued and after it finished): the same jobId with Idempotent-Replay true, exactly one job-queued and one job-finished event. Non-destructive: no task stop, no deletion, no scale change. Run by the human (ruling 29) after a PASS smoke-test.sh and never at the same time as another Haiku run.

limits.failureInjection: one SQS send-message of a malformed body to the job queue; nothing else is mutated

Leave both until cleanup.sh --stage runtime destroys the queues; removing the message earlier is a human-only action. The job record (TTL 168 h), the idempotency record (TTL 24 h) and the audit and answer objects go with the runtime cleanup.
